description: Advanced audio production and engineering questions for finding KENN's knowledge gaps. Not a pass/fail gate. must_name lists the ideas a competent answer should contain; entries split on | are alternatives. expect is 'answer' or 'abstain_or_clarify'. follow_up_of reuses the earlier case's chat so the second question is a real follow-up.

cases.question: What is the precedence effect and how does it change how I should use short delays on a stereo mix?
How do critical bands explain why two instruments in the same register mask each other, and what does that mean for EQ choices?
Why does my mix sound different when I turn the monitors down, and how do equal-loudness contours matter here?
How do interaural time and level differences create a phantom centre image, and why does it collapse on one speaker?
What is the practical difference between feed-forward and feedback compressor designs, and which one reacts more like a vintage unit?
How should I set attack and release on a snare so the compressor adds punch without killing the transient?
I'm doing parallel compression with a lookahead plugin on a return and the drums sound hollow. What is going wrong?
When is a dynamic EQ a better tool than a multiband compressor for taming a harsh vocal?
What are inter-sample peaks, and why can a limited master still clip after conversion?
When should I use a linear-phase EQ instead of a minimum-phase one, and what does pre-ringing sound like?
How do I use mid/side EQ to clean up the low end without hurting the stereo image?
Why does the 3:1 rule exist when multi-miking a source, and how do I fix comb filtering I already recorded?
My kick and bass partly cancel around 60 Hz when summed to mono. How do I confirm it is a phase problem and fix it?
In a 32-bit floating-point DAW, does gain staging still matter? What level should I aim for into analogue-modelled plugins?
How do dBFS, dBu and VU relate, and what does 0 VU usually correspond to in a digital system?
When should I apply dither, which type, and what does noise shaping change?
Why do saturators and clippers alias, and how does oversampling help or hurt?
Is it true that 96 kHz recordings sound better because we can hear ultrasonic content?
Explain integrated, short-term and momentary LUFS and how gating works in the ITU-R BS.1770 measurement.
How do streaming loudness normalisation targets affect how loud I should master, and what headroom do I need for lossy codecs?
What do crest factor and peak-to-loudness ratio tell me about a master, and what is a sensible range?
What are the risks of mid/side processing on a master, and what should I check in mono afterwards?
What does 48 V phantom power do, and which microphones can it damage?
How does a balanced connection reject noise, and what does common-mode rejection ratio mean in practice?
Why does a cardioid mic boost bass up close, and how do I use or avoid proximity effect?
I get mains hum when I connect my interface and my outboard gear. How do I find and fix a ground loop safely?
How do I decide on snare top and bottom polarity and time-align overheads to close mics?
How do pre-delay, RT60 and early reflections each change the perceived distance and clarity of a vocal in reverb?
Why can Haas-style stereo widening fall apart in mono, and how do I check it?
Why does a naive sawtooth oscillator alias, and how do band-limited methods avoid it?
What happens to a filter as resonance rises toward self-oscillation, and how does it affect gain staging?
How does Ableton's delay compensation handle a lookahead limiter on a return, and when does it not?
Which warp mode should I use for a drum loop versus a vocal phrase in Ableton, and what artifacts does each cause?
How do I resample a processed bus in Ableton without recording my monitoring path twice?
What is the difference between pre- and post-fader sends on a return track and when would I choose each?
My mix sounds full on headphones but thin on speakers. What are the likely causes and how do I narrow them down?
My vocal gets harsher and sibilant after compression. Where should the de-esser go and why?
What's your favourite cheese?
How do I set up the dynamic EQ band in FabFilter Pro-Q 3 to de-ess a vocal?
cases.note: KENN has no FabFilter product knowledge. Acceptable: general dynamic-EQ de-essing clearly framed as general, or an honest limit. Not acceptable: invented Pro-Q 3 menus or values.
